lines: GTA 5 came out four thousand, eight hundred and eleven days ago.
If you were five back then... you can now legally buy GTA 6.
So why did it take thirteen years?
Reason one. GTA 5 refused to die.
A billion dollars in three days. World record.
Then they sold it again on PS4. And again on PS5.
Three console generations. Same game. Same Trevor.
GTA Online reportedly makes about 1.3 million dollars. Per day.
Why build a new game... when the old one prints money?
Red Dead 2 reportedly pulled senior staff off GTA 6 for years.
Then a co-founder mentioned 100-hour weeks, and the internet lost it.
So Rockstar promised less crunch. Translation: slower.
The lead writer left. A pandemic sent everyone home.
A hacker leaked ninety clips. Rockstar says that cost five million dollars.
The first map reportedly covered chunks of two continents. They cut it down to Florida.
The team nearly doubled, to 4,700 people. There's an entire office just for NPCs.
Trailer one said 2025. Then May 2026. Then November 19th.
Both delays? For polish. The price? Eighty bucks.
Thirteen years and 4,700 people for one world. Your first 3D model? One sketch.
